originality.rationale: The primary 2026 source defines the robust clique functor and proves ordinary grid results, not the fixed geometric homotopy for layer-swapped prisms. The closest published record summaries on other prism/symmetry constructions do not imply this exact binomial odd-cycle correction. Actual directed searches revealed no duplicate, though the negative search is not a proof of novelty and unindexed stronger work is a residual risk.
residual_risks: Unindexed papers on fixed points of graph-derived simplicial complexes or induced-bipartite-subgraph complexes could contain an equivalent formulation.
Closest published-record summaries alone cannot rule out statements appearing deeper in those full papers.

value.rationale: Exact integral homotopy classification for every robust level on every finite graph with at most one odd cycle, including arbitrary attachments and even cycles, under a natural prism involution. The explicit binomial odd-cycle correction and geometric fixed-space model provide reusable equivariant information and a sharp topological contrast at maximal k; not merely numerical enumeration.
